english: You a samurai? Hand over that wooden sword!
Then take away Gin's wooden sword?
What kind of organization IS it?
No, I'd rather not lick it...
Boss has the punchiest perm in the world!
Boss is punch perm, head and heart!
I said, not the idiot prince!\fWhere's the broker?
Ugh! The idiot prince is the broker?!
HEY! Who the hell are you?!
Waaah! Assassins after all!\fOld man! Fight! Fight them!
What the hell?!\fUseless old geezer!\fThen...\fI'll protect myself!\fGin Tama battle!
Idiot?!\fThe prince IS an idiot, but that isn't his name!
Prince! These must be the ones!
Oh, that would be the prince.
You've got Gin Tama!\fFight and fall like a prince!
Obviously a lie!\fTalk, or I'll kill you!
Don't want your life.\fBut if you're really the broker...\fYou've got THAT, right?
Yes! A real Dragon Tama!\fNever hurts to ask!
Why are you giving them away?!
Hmph! Rare orbs don't grow on trees!
Here, a rare Dragon Tama. Happy now?
Cheap price to save your life.
Should've all asked for rare orbs.
I'm here to kill the broker.
Anyway...\fWhy's a prince a shady broker?
Give us all your Gin Tama?
More pets now...\fThe food bills are killing me.
Well... Only you lot spring to mind...
Oh, yes! Will you protect me?
All right! Take them all!\fJust catch the assassin for me!
It said they'd kill the broker.
You mentioned an assassin earlier, right?
Spent your Gin Tama. Can you win?
Idiot prince! Give me Gin Tama!
You just called me an idiot!
Exactly! We'll get killed at this rate!
Gin! Look!\fPrince Hata has Gin Tama!
Damn it! Where'd Daraku go?!\fI'll ask Otae.
I'm busy. I'll hear it later.\fSeen a sickly-looking Amanto?
Kondo! He got the wrong idea and caused a huge fuss!
He was skulking around here earlier.
Yeah, I went.\fThat's why I'm after Daraku.
What?\fYou saying that makes me want to dig deeper.
Gintoki, I wouldn't get too involved.
Thought you'd say that... Be very careful, then.
Should be around here...\fWhere are you, Daraku?
There you are!\fSo that's where you were hiding!
I was just selling Gin Tama.
Shut it! Trading with Joi rebels changes things!
Used the wrong way, Gin Tama are dangerous weapons.\fNo wonder the Joi rebels want them.
Gin Tama.\fAll the rage in Edo, but who spreads them around? Why?
Joi rebels trading Gin Tama with yakuza? What's going on?
Strange, all right.\fAnd seven rare Dragon Tama supposedly grant a wish.
Fun items, if only people didn't use them for crime.
Just answer! I'm after rare orbs. Where do I get them?
Damn. Can't trust TV stations either.
Gin Tama? Is there a case?
I'm not here to hassle you. Firefighters know Edo, right?
